msg: From what I could tell, colours don't matter. It's like switching lanes in traffic to always be in the best/fastest (most mushrooms) one. Go short gnome until the numbers are low - maybe even once but certainly twice in a row - and then go to tall gnome. Stick with that while it's on the higher end and switch back to short when it dips. Nine is the highest number in one go. Four/five is usually where it switches one way or the other. ALSO: Don't hit the space bar for the mushrooms TOO fast after choosing your gnome, because sometimes I did that. In my brain I'd already pressed it but to the game I was "too slow". It was frustrating, and costs mushrooms.
